messages:
Priya M.: post-interview note: finance folks keep asking for a "quick exports" control thats one tap and uses saved presets. they used words like 'one-button monthly'.

Jonas (Design): uploaded tiny mock: https://redwood.design/mockups/quick-presets-compact  menu off the header CTA with 3 presets + recent row. idea: compact menu that captures scope+timeframe.

Ibrahim: backend needs to materialize presets into files and honor scope/timeframe. also add preset ownership + ACLs (org-admin vs project-owner).

Nora (PM): proposal: show a sticky mini-bar on mobile with totals + primary preset CTA. on desktop keep menu off header CTA. A/B idea: mobile sticky vs header inline menu.

Samir:11 accessibility items: never use icon-only as sole affordance; include aria-label with scope and preset name, e.g. "Download preset: Finance monthly (Org: Acme)". ensure keyboard focus lands on CTA early.

QA-bot: test cases queued: keyboard nav into menu, screen reader announce of preset details, download filename contents and preview row.

Jonas (Design): microcopy suggestion: CTA text "Quick export: Finance monthly (PDF)" when menu closed; file names: <preset-slug>_<org>_<YYYY-MM-DD>.pdf to help users sort downloads. added visually-hidden text for SR.

Ibrahim: impl detail: server should return Content-Disposition filename and a small preview endpoint returning first 10 CSV rows for the UI preview. telemetry: preset_download (id, scope, viewport). audit log for preset CRUD.

Priya M.: product ask: presets should be sharable team-level resources. allow "starred" presets visible in quick row. permission: creator + org-billing-managers can manage.

Samir: accessibility follow-up: when preset menu opens, trap focus, Esc restores focus to CTA; announce "3 presets available". retina focus ring and 4.5:1 contrast for labels.

Jonas (Design): updated frames with compact tokens row under header, sticky mini-bar mock for mobile, and focus states. attaching screenshot in Figma.

Nora (PM): timeline: prototype mobile sticky + header menu for desktop next sprint. we'll run a small usability test and an experiment measuring download completion and "can't find invoice" support mentions.

Ibrahim: I'll stub endpoints and set filename format. throwing tickets for telemetry, ACL, and preview API.

Priya M.: great. closing once Figma + RFC + tickets are linked. :white_check_mark:
